split_algorithm: Sort family IDs lexicographically; Fisher-Yates shuffle using 32-bit LCG state=1664525*state+1013904223, seed 20260912; greedily select families that add training coverage for each operator x (left operand, right operand, result) x value; fill training in shuffled order to round(0.7*families); assign next round(0.15*families) to validation and rest to test.
